newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill ups BRE to long-term "accumulate".
newsitem.headline: Merrill ups BRE to long-term "accumulate".

text.p: Merrill Lynch raised its long-term view on Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA (BRE) to accumulate from neutral after the shares fell 15 percent in zloty terms on the Warsaw bourse over the previous month, Merrill said in a report.

"We think that BRE is now priced at a level which allows long-term outperformance," the report dated October 29 said, adding that BRE had fallen victim to the overall negative market sentiment that sent the main WIG index down 13 percent in the previous month.
It said that estimated annual earnings growth for BRE of 14 percent over the next five years would support above average share performance over that period.

Merrill said it was maintaining its intermediate-term neutral rating for BRE because Merrill's year-end 1996 share price objective for BRE of 84 zlotys was only seven percent above BRE's October 29 close of 78.5 zlotys.
On Wednesday, BRE shares jumped 6.4 percent to 83.5 zlotys.
